# typeassert: alwaysReturns with if-else and switch+default paths
typeassert {
	var x I
	x.M() == 1 -> x.(m1)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type I interface{ M() int }
type m1 int

func (m1) M() int { return 1 }

func g(x I) {
	{
		if x.M() != 1 {
			if true {
				return
			} else {
				return
			}
		}
		_ = x
	}
}

func h(x I) {
	{
		if x.M() != 1 {
			switch 1 {
			case 1:
				return
			default:
				return
			}
		}
		_ = x
	}
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go

+++ new/x.go
@@ -14,6 +14,7 @@
 				return
 			}
 		}
+		x := x.(m1)
 		_ = x
 	}
 }
@@ -28,6 +29,7 @@
 				return
 			}
 		}
+		x := x.(m1)
 		_ = x
 	}
 }
